name: third-party legal terms
description: Third-party legal terms means what the terms of service or use, EULAs, licence agreements, privacy, cookie, usage or acceptable use policies, data processing or service level agreements, or other legal text of another company's service, software, fonts, images or data say, allow, require or prohibit, including summaries and paraphrases of them.
notIncluded: The project's own licence, licence section, licence badge or copyright line; naming the licence of a dependency, such as zod (MIT) or a licence column in a dependency table; deciding to use or avoid a dependency because of its licence; using or installing a service, pricing, seats, usage limits, licence keys, contracts, reminders to check terms later, and unrelated meanings of licence such as professional or driver's licences.
message: The user does not allow third-party legal terms in Markdown files: what other companies' terms of service, EULAs, licence agreements or policies say, allow, require or prohibit. The project's own licence and naming a dependency's licence are fine.
